title: R3: dyadic phase-class ranking with polynomial source copies

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every secret s in Z/NZ, the ONE R3 program of proof.md Sections 2-4, using the exact dyadic class-ranking instrument in class-ranking.md, with n=ceil(log2 N), returns the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On EVERY execution branch, jointly with all other stated resource bounds and the zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has worst-case total charged work T=O(2^(n/9) n^24), with absolute outside constants independent of N,s,outcomes. The finite exhaustive n<256 branch is included. Its exact representative growth index is 1.

For every integer N>=2 and every secret s in Z/NZ, the ONE R3 program of proof.md Sections 2-4, using the exact dyadic class-ranking instrument in class-ranking.md, with n=ceil(log2 N), returns the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On EVERY execution branch, jointly with all other stated resource bounds and the zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has peak ordinary classical bits S_C=O(n^2), with absolute outside constants independent of N,s,outcomes. The finite exhaustive n<256 branch is included. Its exact representative growth index is 0.

For every integer N>=2 and every secret s in Z/NZ, the ONE R3 program of proof.md Sections 2-4, using the exact dyadic class-ranking instrument in class-ranking.md, with n=ceil(log2 N), returns the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On EVERY execution branch, jointly with all other stated resource bounds and the zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has peak physical accessible qubits S_Q=O(2^(n/9) n^5), including the entire dense helper prefix, unused cells, basis records, canonical tables, rank/inverse scratch, Cartesian metadata and source staging, with absolute outside constants independent of N,s,outcomes. The finite exhaustive n<256 branch is included. Its exact representative growth index is 1.

For every integer N>=2 and every secret s in Z/NZ, the ONE R3 program of proof.md Sections 2-4, using the exact dyadic class-ranking instrument in class-ranking.md, with n=ceil(log2 N), returns the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On EVERY execution branch, jointly with all other stated resource bounds and the zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has total original source copies Q=O(n^4), including every rejected label, failed combination and parity repeat, with absolute outside constants independent of N,s,outcomes. The finite exhaustive n<256 branch is included. Its exact representative growth index is 0.

For the same ONE R3 configuration of proof.md Sections 2-4 and class-ranking.md, the proved malformed-sample fraction is epsilon(n)=0: every original acquired copy is an independent ideal coset state. For every N>=2 and every s, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8 jointly with all four branchwise resource bounds. No positive tolerance or impossibility of positive tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
